verdict.rationale: Adyen's risk engine can route transactions to a 'review' outcome, where a reviewer accesses the case in the Customer Area and accepts or rejects it. Webhooks can also flag that a payment was sent to case management, so a basic manual review workflow exists. However, nothing in the evidence describes the team-workflow elements of the story. Missing for 10: case assignment to specific reviewers, escalation paths, SLAs/timers on review queues, a decision audit trail showing who approved what and why, and any independent corroboration.
